title: Involve customers and sales in discovery
summary: Business products have buyers, users and sales teams with different views. Involve them in discovery without letting the loudest customer set the roadmap.

beginner: Talk to sales and customer success about what they hear.
Interview users and buyers at several customers, not just one.
Separate what customers ask for from the problem behind it.
Check how many customers share each problem.
Share what you learned with sales.
intermediate: Research across several customers and roles.
Size problems across the customer base.
experienced: Balance key accounts with the wider market.
Use win and loss analysis to shape strategy.

toolExamples.notion: Keep a customer request database linked to problems.
toolExamples.miro: Map needs by customer and role.
